name: repair-pre-review-live-proof-brand-actor-baseline
title: Repair canonical pre-review live-proof execution after identity cutover
description: The registered pre-review live-proof command fails on clean current main before producing authority evidence: the smoke reads the retired .lattice-codex adapter path although the tracked canonical assets are under .proof-or-stop-codex, and the registered acceptance rollout cohort sets PROOF_OR_STOP_AGENT=acceptance-rollout-verifier while that exact internal verifier identity is rejected by the dispatch mutation guard. Reproduce both failures, make canonical path resolution and least-privilege internal verifier authority explicit, and prove the registered cohort plus live-proof command reaches Green without weakening unknown-actor denial.
